examples.text: „Die Revolution ist wie Saturn, sie frißt ihre eigenen Kinder.“

examples.text: „In den Kärntner Landesspitälern bahnt sich ein Umsturz an.“

glosses: gewaltsame Änderung eines bestehenden gesellschaftlich-politischen Zustandes

examples.text: „Der nach dem Umsturz aus der Hauptstadt Bischkek geflohene kirgisische Präsident Kurmanbek Bakijew lehnt seinen Rücktritt ab und will mit den Putschisten verhandeln.“

„Wohin sie nicht mehr gelangten, dort verbreitete sich dennoch durch Gerüchte und private Berichte die Nachricht vom erfolgreichen Umsturz ausgerechnet in Kiel, dem Hauptqaurtier der stets besonders kaisertreuen Flotte.“
„Es war nicht leicht, das durchzusetzen, obschon doch Revolution ist – denn dieser ganze Umsturz ist nur ein bisschen Windgekräusel an der Oberfläche.“

glosses: A political upheaval in a government or state characterized by great change.

examples.text: The revolution had completely transformed the monarchy into a republic.

Una rivoluzione è certamente la cosa più autoritaria che ci sia: è l'atto per il quale una parte della popolazione impone la sua volontà all'altra parte per mezzo di fucili, baionette e cannoni; mezzi autoritari, se ce ne sono; e il partito vittorioso, se non vuole aver combattuto invano, deve continuare questo dominio col terrore che le sue armi inspirano ai reazionari.
The essence of every revolution consisted and consists in putting a new class in power, thus enabling it to realize its own program in life.

glosses: The popular removal and replacement of a government, especially by sudden violent action.

examples.text: For a long time the dormouse and polecat had seemed to him overfeeble enemies for his restless valour, even as the granary floor seemed to afford too narrow a field. glosses: Rotation: the turning of an object around an axis, one complete turn of an object during rotation.

examples.text: The ratio between the speeds of revolution of wheel and disc is substantially equal to the reciprocal of the ratio between the diameter of the wheel and the diameter of the mean contact circle on the disc.
The Earth has two motions: a daily revolution (or turning around) upon its axis, and a yearly course around the sun.
Numerous cases are recorded which incontestibly prove that during pregnancy, the uterus perform a half or even a complete revolution, on itself, producing torsion of the cervix […]

glosses: In the case of celestial bodies, the traversal of one body along an orbit around another body.

examples.text: It takes 365 days for the Earth to complete one revolution around the sun.
